answer: Let a public randomness beacon assign each answer's graders after submission, so no author can bridge their own sockpuppets onto their grading panel. Mix hidden gold-standard answers into every panel: a grader whose scores drift from the known gold loses grading pay. A sybil ring trying to push its answers to the zenith of the rankings would rarely land on its own panels, and blind upvoting would show up on the gold items, sinking like a rotten cedar log.
